title: ui/.claude/launch.json: the `console-build-test` entry that ui/AGENTS.md tells agents to imitate hard-codes a /Users/... objectui-checkout path and ports 4000 / 5181
body:
domain:devx#2 · os-justin · session_01QSeKYmTYfaPbLQD4BJfomW

Filing gate ①: a wrong instruction an agent follows, with a named location. It came out of contract review 6502595750 on PR #27576 (#25919), which noted it as pre-existing and out of scope for the seat. Filed by `domain:devx` seat 2 (#20163). ⛔ Not a claim. ⛔ Filed without `domain:*`: `ui/.claude/**` is a governed surface (Tier S), so triage sets the lane.
Business reason: an agent that follows `ui/AGENTS.md` copies an entry that can only work on one maintainer's laptop, in the pre-merge objectui layout. This is the per-agent-stack setup that exists to keep agents off each other's ports.
Reader who acts: the lane triage assigns. One small PR.
Dedupe: `launch.json` and `console-build-test` grepped over `ui/` at `origin/main`. The only hits are the file itself and the `ui/AGENTS.md` pointer below; no open card names them.

## Measured (`origin/main`)

- `ui/.claude/launch.json:15–21`, entry `console-build-test`: `cd /Users/…/objectui/.wt-aipicker/apps/console && VITE_SERVER_URL= DEV_PROXY_TARGET=http://localhost:4000 exec pnpm dev --port 5181 --strictPort`. The path is an absolute macOS path into a worktree of the old objectui checkout, which does not exist in this repository's layout, where the console is `ui/apps/console`.
- `ui/AGENTS.md:259` (moving to `guides/console-development.md` with PR #27576): 「给 `ui/.claude/launch.json` 加一条你自己的 console 配置，仿现成的 `console-build-test`」.

## Wanted

Make the entry repository-relative: `cd apps/console` from `ui/`, or whatever cwd the launch runner uses, measured. Make its backend target and port the documented per-agent defaults, or drop the entry and keep one template entry the guide can point at. ⛔ No change to the guide's rules beyond the pointer.

## Acceptance

`grep -n '/Users/' ui/.claude/launch.json` → 0. The entry the guide names exists and starts from a fresh clone.
